threat_model.risk: Private key leakage into unencrypted backup bundles or manifests
threat_model.historical_vulnerability: Regex string scanner bypass via raw binary keys or non-standard encodings

mitigation_architecture.guarantee: By construction, metadata bundle types do not contain private keys
mitigation_architecture.public_key_verification: Strict 32-byte Ed25519 public key hex validation

escrow_key_lifecycle.encryption: AES-256-GCM envelope encryption with unique nonce and 16-byte auth tag

operational_security_advisory.offline_revocation_reality: Cryptographic revocation is only enforceable when updated Trust Store / CRL is delivered to storage nodes. Offline isolated nodes cannot detect key compromise without explicit trust sync.
